name: LOLIN S3 Mini
notes: LOLIN (WEMOS) S3 Mini v1.0.0: 34.3 x 25.4 mm, bare ESP32-S3FH4R2 (4 MB flash, 2 MB quad PSRAM), USB-C, PCB trace antenna. Two pin rows per side - the outer rows match the LOLIN D1 mini footprint, so D1 mini shields fit; the inner rows are drawn as the inboard pad strip here.

GPIO35/36/37 ARE usable on this board: the S3FH4R2's in-package PSRAM is quad, not octal, so the generic S3 note about octal-PSRAM (R8/R16V) modules does not apply here. 35/36 are even the Arduino default I2C pins. The bare chip also exposes GPIO33/34, which WROOM-1 modules keep for themselves.
RGB LED: a WS2812B on GPIO47 (not broken out) - drive it with the NeoPixel protocol / rgbLedWrite(), not digitalWrite().

No USB-UART bridge: the console is the S3's native USB-CDC (GPIO19/20, wired only to the USB-C connector). If the firmware wedges, hold BOOT (GPIO0, not broken out) and tap RST to enter the ROM downloader.
Arduino defaults: TX=GPIO43, RX=GPIO44 (real UART0), I2C SDA=GPIO35 / SCL=GPIO36, SPI SCK=12 / MISO=13 / MOSI=11 / SS=10 - matching the D1 mini shield positions.

headers.surfacePadCaption: inner pin rows - real through-hole header pads inboard of the D1-mini-footprint outer rows

36.note: Arduino default I2C SCL (the D1 mini D1/SCL shield position). Usable here: the S3FH4R2 has quad PSRAM, so GPIO35-37 are free.

37.note: Usable here: the S3FH4R2 has quad PSRAM - the octal-PSRAM reservation does not apply.
